notes.title: v1.05 - Better achievement checking, reduced rank requirements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In some cases, lifetime score achievements weren't correctly being triggered. That should be fixed now. 
[*] Reduced requirements for unlockable ships and powerups. You may see a bunch of new things unlocked.
[/list]
